scope: Native host default-feature headless logic tests plus separately recorded rendering/interaction and browser parity evidence.
acceptance: Tests must exit zero and execute at least one test; suite wall time is descriptive. Device/rendering review requires evidence and has no invented performance threshold.

steps.instructions: Follow procedures/gui.md for idle/active/scaling trials and native/browser parity. Attach raw captures and screenshots with backend, physical viewport and scale. Do not report test elapsed time as frame time.
Follow procedures/review.md for shared-rule placement, data bounds and window lifecycle; attach source-based findings and exclusions.
